inlines.v: ROOST, noun The pole or other support on which fowls rest at night. He clapp'd his wings upon his roost At roost in a state for rest and sleep. ROOST, verb intransitive 1. To sit, rest or sleep, as fowls on a pole, tree or other thing at night. 2. To lodge, in burlesque.
